title: Stroll
paragraphs: “He’s still sleeping? But it’s already noon…”

Father looks out the window. After our detour to the Four Saints Church… it’s well past noon. Well, that pig of a king is infamous for his excessive nightly activities. His sleep schedule is likely reversed, making daytime his resting hours.

“We have scheduled the Four Holy Heroes’ audience as the first meeting of the day. However… if we were to wake His Majesty forcefully, his mood would be absolutely dreadful. Would you be willing to wait until he wakes naturally?”
“Well… if that’s how it is, I guess we don’t have a choice.”
“What should we do in the meantime?”
“We will prepare a room for you. Please bear with us for a while.”
That being said, this place is practically enemy territory.

What’s the best course of action here? If we follow the soldiers’ instructions too naively, we might end up being led straight to Takt and caught in another trap. Well, Father had already given me some tips on how to navigate situations like this, so we can handle it. In the worst case, we’ll just have to adapt accordingly.
“Motoyasu-kun…”
“In that case, would it be acceptable if we waited in the carriage instead?”
“If that is what the Heroes wish…”
Éclair seems somewhat exasperated. Well, coming all the way here only to wait in the carriage does seem a bit ridiculous.
“In that case, this is unrelated, but is the Queen of Melromarc currently in this country?”
This is Éclair’s main objective. The soldier answers her question politely.
“One moment… It appears that she is present.”
“The Queen of Melromarc is in Faubrey?”
“Given the ongoing diplomatic efforts, it was always a possibility…”
“At present, she is participating in negotiations within Faubrey Castle. Would you like me to request an audience for you?”
“Please do. Inform her that Éclair Seaetto, traveling alongside the Four Holy Heroes, has arrived.”

Father and the others look worried as Éclair moves forward with her plan to meet the Queen. That’s understandable. Melromarc’s actions have been suspicious this time around, so approaching carelessly might be dangerous.
“Are you sure about this?”
“There is no problem. I will first attempt to persuade the Queen. The Queen I know would respond with reason, no matter the circumstances.”
“Even to a knight of her own country, arriving alongside the hero who killed her husband and daughter?”
“…This is my duty. Even if it costs me my life, I will persuade the Queen. If something happens to me, you may cut off Melromarc entirely.”
“Eclair-san…”Father and the others are all gazing at Éclair’s back like maidens in admiration.
Well, I have to admit, Éclair did look pretty cool just now. More than that, though, they’re probably just worried about her, since she’s been their companion all this time.
“If the Heroes come with me, it might complicate things. Let me try talking to her alone first. In the meantime, please rest in the carriage.”
“Got it. Well, we just have to wait until the king wakes up. Hopefully, things will be sorted out by evening.”
“Not waking him just because he’s sleeping… This country’s king doesn’t seem very reliable either.”
“Still, isn’t this better than being in Melromarc or Siltvelt?”
“True. It’s a major power, after all. Worst case, we could just meet with the ministers or other key officials instead.”
“The king already scheduled the audience first. Wouldn’t meeting them without his permission be considered a violation?”
Father’s insight makes the soldiers nod repeatedly. As expected of him—he’s right on the mark.
“Ah, so he’s like a spoiled child, huh? He insisted on being the first to have an audience?”
“And since no one wants to risk defying him, the key officials are forced to stay out of it… That’s the situation, right?”
“What a hassle.”

It was the same at first with that crimson swine… Now that I think about it, when we brought the crimson swine here, he was actually awake. That time, he must’ve made an exception and woken up early because he was eagerly waiting for the crimson swine’s arrival. I recall the two of them getting along quite well.
…Or am I imagining things?
“Alright then, let’s leave the meeting with the Queen of Melromarc to Éclair and wait here for now.”
“Sounds good. Maybe we should take a nap in the carriage.”
“Or we could go check out the town… If we’re allowed to come and go freely, a little walk might be nice.”
“Itsuki, you should be careful. It might be dangerous.”
Takt and his followers are still here. Until we eliminate those obstacles, we don’t know when we might be attacked. Unlocking our weapons and gathering intel can wait until things are more secure.
“Ugh… This is such a hassle. I really need to learn Motoyasu-san’s teleportation skill soon. That way, we could kill time in some far-off town.”
“Yeah… It’d be good to pick that up as soon as possible.”
“Well then, Heroes, please be patient for a while.”
With that, Éclair followed the soldier deeper into the castle. We turned back toward the carriage.
“A battle could break out at any moment… but it’s so peaceful right now.”
“The sky is so clear.”

The parking lot here is surprisingly large. There are various carriages and wagons parked, and nearby, there are stables for Filo Rials as well as enclosures for other kinds of magical beasts. It looks like there’s even an enclosure for horses—monsters classified as “Horse.” There are some unusual ones too, like Griffins and Hippogriffs. And of course, they’ve got a stable for dragons, the favorite of my rival… Disgusting. Well, I suppose taking a peek wouldn’t hurt, but the stench would probably be unbearable. We’re resting in the parking area assigned to us. After all, it’s been a long journey. Father said this is a good opportunity to get everything organized. Ren and Itsuki are lying down inside the carriage. Traveling by carriage is tiring in its own way, and we’ve been fighting quite a bit over the past few days, so they must be exhausted. Father is busy organizing our belongings. As for me, I’m taking this rare chance to draw Filo-tan again. Yuki-chan and the others are playing outside the carriage, and both my assistant and my rival are playing as well. The mole is helping Father with the sorting.
“Waaah… Filo Rials—”
“Yeah, that’s right!”

I can hear Yuki-chan and the others laughing happily. Now then… I go over the strategy Father told me once more. First, we meet with the king here… Then do this, and that… And as for Takt, we’ll handle him like this…
After that, we wait a bit, and then…
“Alright, all set.”
“Um… Shield Hero…”
“What is it, Windia-chan?”
Father stepped out of the carriage to check the surroundings. Shortly after, he called out to us inside the carriage.
“Everyone! Come here for a second!”
“Mm… What’s going on?”
Ren and Itsuki stirred awake, still looking drowsy. I also got out of the carriage, wondering what was happening.
“Windia-chan, can you explain the situation?”
“Huh? Oh, yeah. I was resting outside with Gaelion, and then the Filo Rials were wandering around, taking a little walk.”
“Okay, and then?”
“At first, there were three of them started playing tag, but at some point, there was an extra kid, and they ended up playing together for quite a while—”
“Then, just a little while ago, they walked off in that direction!”
My assistant and my rival pointed toward a fork in the road leading away from the castle.
“Wait a minute, are you telling me those Filo Rials just went off wandering on their own?”
“They are quite curious creatures.”

But what bothers me is how one extra suddenly appeared among them. This place is enemy territory—practically Takt’s stronghold. We have no idea what could happen here, so I’d rather Yuki-chan and the others stay somewhere safe.
“Now that you mention it… The Filo Rials do have a habit of wandering off, don’t they?”
“It seems to be part of their natural scouting instinct…”
“Yeah, so I didn’t think much of it at first, but… we kind of lost track of where they went, and I figured we should check before going after them…”

My assistant, as always, has been keeping a close eye on things. Even though he’s clashed with the Filo Rials before, it’s not like he doesn’t understand them. I’ll give him credit for that much. In the first world, my assistant looked after not only dragons and Filo Rials but also various other monsters. From the caterpillar-like creatures and giant worms in Father’s domain to all sorts of other monsters, he was beloved by many of them. As someone who worships the Filo Rials, I could probably trust him—so long as I ignore the whole dragon thing.
